name: Earth Falls (1-2)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Quest #22: Friends in Need

disable: DC 15 Arcana,nature,thievery check (trained) two times to counter the planar energies.
routine: (3 actions) On its turn each round, two new 10-foot-square sinkholes, 5 feet deep, randomly appear on the map. Until a creature of size Small or larger steps in the area of one, it looks no different than the surrounding area. If a creature takes an action to seek and succeeds at a DC 15 Perception check check, it notices the hazardous square.

items.name: A Pit!
items.text:
Trigger A creature of size Small or larger steps into an affected square or is standing on a square that becomes a sinkhole

---
Effect The ground beneath the creature gives way. The creature must attempt a DC 15 Reflex save Save.

---
Critical Success The creature is able to move to an adjacent square.

Success The creature grabs an edge.

Failure The creature falls into the pit and lands Prone. It takes 2 bludgeoning damage. Due to roots in the pit wall, it is easy to climb out of, requiring only a DC 10 Athletics check check.

text: The area has become unstable as part of the swamp is pulled into another plane, causing sinkholes to spontaneously form.
